LESSON: BELIEF IN PROPHETS 3.3.1 QUALITIES OF PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can qualities of the prophets be applied in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the qualities of prophets for character formation
2. apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain the qualities of prophets for character formation
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the qualities of prophets for character formation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives
   In simple words: practise until you can apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets in the examples.
2. Explain Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
4. Show that you can: explain the qualities of prophets for character formation

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Search for information on the qualities of prophets from digital, devices/books/resource persons and display in class,
2. Role-play situations that demonstrate values learnt from the qualities of the prophets (e.g. honesty, obedience, patience),
3. Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication is developed as learners narrate a story of any prophet that shows these qualities.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can qualities of the prophets be applied in daily life?
2. Why are prophets regarded as role models?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the qualities of prophets for character formation
2. apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
